::api-operation{method="DELETE" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/unbilled_charges/{id}"}
#docs
Marks a `pending` charge `voided` — the state a cancel with `unbilled_charges_option: delete` leaves — so no renewal or `invoice_now` bills it. A queued charge has posted nothing to the ledger, so nothing is reversed. 409 when it is already billed (reverse it with a credit note) or already deleted.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The unbilled charge's id. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `unbilled_charge`. One of `unbilled_charge`. |
| `id` | `string` | The unbilled charge id. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer id. |
| `description` | `string` | The charge description. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The charge amount in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency code. |
| `status` | `string` | The charge state. |
| `quantity` | `integer` | The quantity. |
| `entity_type` | `string` | The kind of thing charged. |
| `period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | Start of the period that the charge covers. |
| `period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | End of the period that the charge covers. |
| `invoice` | `string` | The invoice that billed the charge. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the charge was created. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The voided unbilled_charge |
| `404` | No such unbilled charge |
| `409` | Already billed or deleted |

```bash [Request]
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
